No data, control or clock crossing exists. Shared raw rst_n is a reset-release (RDC) obligation, and RDC rules are disabled under --goal cdc. Caveat: this is the same isolated-domain template as the other 13 controls, not a class-specific safe lookalike, so it measures generic false alarms only. Raw rst_n release, recovery/removal and physical timing remain external obligations outside this label.
